string.text: The city is still alive in these notes. Bring me ten\nto begin with. We will start a new part of the archive.
I have the first ten notes. Take them.
I have kept the first ten. Bring me fourteen more.\nThere are still gaps in these stories.
I brought fourteen more. You now have twenty-four.
Twenty notes remain. Bring them, and the collection\nwill be complete. We must preserve these stories.
The last twenty. All forty-four notes are here.
Then do not rush. Return when you have them.
I will keep these pages safe. Thank you for bringing them.
Keep the notes for now. We will return to this later.

The collection is complete. Thank you. You have helped
preserve the memory of a city that did not yet know
what fate awaited it. In these pages, people are still
raising children, looking forward to holidays and
making plans for tomorrow. They do not know that one day
they will have to leave their homes.
I will keep these pages safe, so that the life this city
lost will not be forgotten.
